scope: capability test only; no profitability, validation or deployment claim

environment.isolation: copy-on-write under academia/runtime; History mounted read-only
environment.browser: ephemeral PinchTab 0.14.0 used only to diagnose project resource resolution

structural_check.observed_exit_change: long and short signal exits were wrapped with an AND false branch; ATR-based protective exits remained
structural_check.warning: The surviving modification can disable rule exits. This proves part scoping, not that the improvement is economically sensible. Semantic lint remains mandatory.

operational_lessons: The resource resolver reads embedded Symbol date ranges and can block on inactive cross-check setups; sanitizing only the active Setup is insufficient.
A CFX must contain config.xml and the referenced task XML; stale unreferenced task XML should not be carried into a minimal capability project.
History files without the matching data.db catalog can exist on disk yet remain unresolved to SQ.
Databank-wide Improver requires a total-generated or time-limit ranking stop. Build 143 recognizes the literal time-limit; databank-full is rejected for this mode.
A candidate must be physically present in the named input databank and the start log must prove that it loaded.
decision: Improver exit-only execution is locally tested. Do not promote its survivor: the sample is one base strategy, has no OOS, all variants passed permissive filters and the selected rule-exit change is semantically suspicious.
